GitHub reported MERGEABLE and CLEAN, because the branch\\u0027s tip merges cleanly, but gh pr merge --rebase exited 1 with GraphQL: This branch can\\u0027t be rebased (mergePullRequest). A dry-run rebase conflicted at one mid-branch commit in tests/Hall9k.Tests/Integration/CloseoutEngineTests.cs after 8222011c merged: an earlier commit touched a line a later commit restored, so only the commit-by-commit replay conflicts. The closeout monitor reads mergeable, so it never saw a conflict and spent attempts on the same refusal (CloseoutEngine.cs:1851-1875). The window dispatched h9k pr resolve 0611dc26 --rebase by hand.
